name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem or Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the use case it would enable.

**Example**: "I want to deploy Graphiti on DigitalOcean, but there's currently no installation script for that platform."

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered any alternative approaches? If so, please describe them.

## Platform/Component

Which part of the project would this feature affect?

- [ ] Installation scripts (GCP, AWS, Azure, SSH)
- [ ] Common utilities
- [ ] Docker configuration
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Testing
- [ ] New platform support
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## Implementation Complexity

How complex do you think this feature would be to implement?

- [ ] Simple (minor changes)
- [ ] Moderate (some refactoring needed)
- [ ] Complex (significant changes)
- [ ] Not sure

## Benefits

What are the main benefits of implementing this feature?

- 
- 
- 

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Willingness to Contribute

Would you be willing to contribute to implementing this feature?

- [ ] Yes, I can implement this
- [ ] Yes, with guidance
- [ ] No, but I can help test
- [ ] No, just suggesting
